    • mutate

      public T mutate()
      Gets the value for in-place mutation and marks this tunable changed.

      This is useful for mutable structured/protobuf values where modifying the object returned by get() would otherwise bypass set(Object) and not notify backends. For immutable values, prefer set(Object). For variable-length arrays, use set(Object) with a new array to change the length.

      Returns:
      mutable value
